response.rationale: The item is defective (defective == True) and not final sale (final_sale == False), satisfying RET-020, which at priority 90 dominates the standard out-of-window ineligibility rule RET-008 (priority 10). The only higher-priority rule, RET-012, does not apply since final_sale is False. Defective items may be returned regardless of the standard 30-day window.
